authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government / contributing local planning authorities
note: Previously unused official public no-login real-data source window. Planning Data reports 104,788 tree-preservation-zone records from 82 providers; the dataset represents extents of groups of trees covered by tree preservation orders, and official entity records can expose permanent references, organisation identifiers and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry. A bounded window of at most 50 candidate records was considered solely to resolve the fixed future_growth_3 partition/geography. Round65 remote checkpoint/readback still exposes no authoritative tree-preservation-zone reference, tree-preservation-order reference, local-authority-district/organisation identifier, local-plan reference, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, title identifier, or equivalent selector binding any candidate zone to this fixed slot. Choosing one would invent partition ownership. Therefore no coverage_area_id or Polygon/MultiPolygon is selected for this slot, no AAYS_SOURCE_AREA_V1 record is accepted, no canonical parcel is accepted, and no future_growth_new Plan0 package is emitted.
